note: Labels are rule-engine output. 'physics' rules use verified inputs; every constant in heuristics is a teaching assumption, not real data.

rules.MASS_OVER_CAPACITY: total <= 0.9 x launcher capacity (LEO capacity; GTO capacity for GTO) [physics inputs verified, margin heuristic]
rules.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: launcher launch_cost_usd <= budget (cost verified from Launch Library; component prices unknown so excluded)
rules.DELTA_V_SHORT: Isp*g0*ln(m0/mf) >= 1.1 x required dv (rocket equation; required dv from Hohmann/escape on verified GM, radii, semi-major axes)
rules.THRUST_TOO_LOW: propellant needed for the required dv burned at total thrust must take <= 1 year
rules.POWER_SHORT: array BOL power x 0.8 x (destination irradiance / Earth irradiance) >= 1.15 x load (irradiance from NASA NSSDC fact sheets)
rules.BAND_MISMATCH: radio and antenna frequency bands must match when both known
rules.DATA_RATE_LOW: radio max data rate >= destination requirement (game parameter)
rules.LINK_MARGIN_LOW: Friis link margin >= 3 dB (5 W Tx, 35 dBi ground antenna, Eb/N0 10 dB are heuristics; frequency, gain, distance verified)
rules.MISSING_*: launcher, propulsion, solar array, radio, antenna and at least one instrument are required

not_modelled: batteries/eclipse, thermal, attitude control, component prices, launch fairing size, mission duration, radiation, launch window
